data.name: Disaster Janitor 🧽
data.description:
Grab your mop and suit up as a disaster janitor! 

How to play
• Equip a mop, or any tool in your inventory.
• Scrub splatters and graffiti, place waste in bins, incinerate waste for money, use money to purchase locker tools.
• Contamination rises nonstop! Pest hits spike it, so keep it low.
• Handle pests carefully! Pests and pathogens can wake, and crawlers lurk. Use weapons to take them out.

Epic Features
• Procedurally generated placement of waste and other content. Every shift is different.
• Physics-based content (yes, the mop bristles flop)

⚠️ This is an alpha game: Bugs are normal. Found a bug? Drop it in the Disaster Janitor server.
⚠️ Exploits lead to a permanent ban, including bans on any detected ALT accounts.
